title: Code expressions used as credential values: must be flagged
summary: Values that look like code references but are not (dotted or underscored literals, a near-miss root name). Covers 3 inputs.
rationale: Code that reads a secret from configuration is the recommended pattern. The expression is a reference and holds no secret.
